text: The bug is in `page_count`: `total_items // per_page + 1` overcounts by one page when the item count is an exact multiple of `per_page` (9 // 3 + 1 = 4 instead of 3). The correct ceiling division is `(total_items + per_page - 1) // per_page`, and per the docstring the result must be at least 1 (an empty collection still has one empty page).
